html:
The 2023 Gabonese coup d'état took place on 30 August 2023, when army officers seized power minutes after President Ali Bongo was declared winner of a disputed election.

Ali Bongo had succeeded his father Omar Bongo in 2009 and had been weakened by a stroke in 2018. The officers, led by General Brice Oligui Nguema, head of the Republican Guard and a cousin of the president, put him under house arrest and cancelled the result. Crowds in Libreville celebrated.

The coup ended the Bongo family's 56 years in power. It came during a wave of coups in former French colonies, including Mali and Niger. Oligui Nguema promised a return to civilian rule and won a presidential election in 2025 by a large margin.
sum: The 2023 Gabonese coup d'état took place on 30 August 2023, when army officers seized power minutes after President Ali Bongo was declared winner of a disputed election.
